notes: Single-family build complete = `style` on the Calling path + 3 distinct taken cards from `cards`, of which at most 1 is in `generic_cards` and at least 1 is in `core` (builds with an empty `core` are exempt and carry a `core_gap` note). Cross build complete = `second_family` held + at least `needed_second` (2) taken from `cards` (the second family's) + at least `needed_start` (1) taken from the counting `cards` of the single build named in `start_from`; at most 1 generic in all. `pair_cards` (Reaction cards: dead until a family with a pairing status is held and built) and `grown_cards` (thunderstruck: needs a grown heavy form) never count for single builds; they are reported as offered / taken only. Cross builds list their pair cards in `cards`, since the pairing family is the build. By drift N = Dreams at rests strictly before N (by 25 = 10..20, by 50 = 10..45, by 75 = 10..70). Drift 5 = the Calling style, no Dream. Family picks after 10, 35, 60 (2 of the families not held, then 2 of 2, then 1 of 1); the pick comes before that rest's Dream and its root Warden counts as built only after that Dream. Simulated player: start family forced (the real fresh first pick shows 2 of 4; the test also reports the real-odds share); at each Dream takes the counting card that moves it closest to complete (rarest first, ties random), else any other counting card within the generic cap, else a random card with no family Need (never lucid_dream), else a random card; never lets a Dream pass; Clear Skies at every Omen (Omens untouched). Test: tests/test_build_odds.gd reads a copy of this file at res://tests/data/build_sheet.json.
